messages:
jamie: quick post-all-hands thread for the finance/budget questions. i'll summarize answers below.

kevin: could you confirm runway under baseline vs downside? slides were quick.

elaine: baseline ~18 months. downside (slower sales + full hiring) ~13 months. we have hiring pause levers ready.

matt: burn: current gross ~5.4M/mo; baseline net burn trends to ~3.1-3.4M/mo by EOY with sales assumptions. i will share the forecast link.

jamie: @matt please share the model and list which hires are prioritized.

matt: shared (view only): https://short.link/redwood-fin-jan. Prioritized: 2 infra SREs, 1 security, 2 AEs. others are deferrable/backfill.

kevin: procurement thresholds? vendor onboarding SLA?

devon: new rules start Mon: >=$10k needs finance + cost owner; >=$50k needs exec sponsor. Standard SLA 3 business days; new vendor onboarding up to 7 days.

kevin: we have a partner who needs onboarding <7 days. any expedite?

devon: tag @devon and @finance-bot with "expedite" on the /po-request; we'll try 48-72 hours but legal/security approvals still apply.

jamie: can you paste the PO fields teams should fill?

devon: PO fields: vendor_name, amount, cost_center, justification, contract_term, contact, expedite_flag. Approval flow: cost-owner -> finance -> exec (if >=50k).

jamie: Dedicated reserved capacity questions: any change to approval bar?

matt: Dedicated still supported but new large commits need a 9-12 month ROI case. i'll post a one-pager template (throughput lift, cost/unit, ops savings, break-even).

jamie: final ask: can leadership post a pinned FAQ in #all-hands summarizing thresholds, card limits, and runway bullets?

elaine: yes 1 will post a pinned FAQ and a 2-min Loom covering the procurement flow.

finance-bot: Procurement workflow live 2026-03-23T15:10:00Z. Use /po-request to start. :robot_face: 

jamie: thanks team, closing thread. :slightly_smiling_face:
